title: No reforms for CLAT 2027 as NLU Consortium releases expert committee report 5 months after submission
description: The Governing Body of the Consortium of National Law Universities has decided not to change the pattern or syllabus of the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) 2027, even as it published the Expert Committee's long-awaited report on reforming the exam.The development was notified through a July 21 press release on the Consortium's website.The Committee's report recommends changing the exam's focus from testing legal and general knowledge to evaluating logical and legal aptitude, with greater emphasi
